venue.name: Amore Mio
venue.description: Amore Mio restaurant was opened 20 years ago by Suzannea and Shlomi Salomon. The couple returned to Israel about from a stay in Italy and opened the legendary "Pizza Pazza” and brought to Israel new dishes  such as focaccia, calzone and lasagna
